text: Germany take on Luxembourg in Sinsheim as World Cup qualification continues.
Nick Vultemarde not quite at 100% but leading the line here this evening.
12th minute and Germany with the perfect start.
David Rau with the dead ball situation.
Beautiful curler up and over the wall and 1-0.
Then a handball inside the box, VAR taking another look.
A red card for Karlsson as Luxembourg down to 10 men and trailing by to Joshua Kimmich.
Cool as a cucumber from the spot and the fans in Sinsheim enjoying themselves thoroughly.
They thought they were celebrating a third in the 24th minute.
Looked like it was in the back of the net, it was actually round the back of the goal.
And therefore still just 2-0.
48th minute of play now, early into the second half and Germany would have their third.
Gnabryk would have his goal, a really well taken one as well.
Bit of good luck there on the rebound off the defender but nothing wrong with the finish.
And just moments later there was a fourth, Joshua Kimmich with his first ever brace for the national team.
The Germany captain enjoying that one and celebrating in style.
An easy tap in from close range.
Germany in cruise control.
Florian Wietz nearly with the fifth scored from a free kick against Northern Ireland.
Wasn't meant to be here on this Saturday evening in Sinsheim.
And then Jonathan Burkhardt nearly with his first goal for the national team.
The header just wide, possibly an offside position.
But it didn't matter in the end, 4-0 enough to get the job done.
Six points on the board for Julian Nagelsmann and company.
